name: Jefferson Fracture of C1
definition: Burst-type fracture of the atlas (C1), often caused by axial loading and potentially associated with transverse ligament injury.

typical: Upper neck pain after axial trauma

investigations.principle: CT defines C1 fracture morphology; MRI evaluates transverse ligament and neural structures when needed.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Stability depends substantially on ligament integrity, not fracture appearance alone.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna concepts remain secondary to modern upper-cervical stability assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Burst-type fracture of the atlas (C1), often caused by axial loading and potentially associated with transverse ligament injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
